name: Palme
author: ultralazr
description: The palm-shaped string loudspeaker of the Ondes Martenot. Twelve strings, tuned chromatically from a root, ring in sympathy with what you play. Page 2 morphs the soundboard into a gong.
credits: Musica Obscura by ultralazr, from op1r, ported to kennel by Hundekraft
